civic_humanism.name: Civic Humanism
civic_humanism.observation: The town chancellor writes letters in the old learned style, praising citizens who serve the republic over devotees who flee it.
civic_humanism.ability_reason: Letters in the old style praise active citizenship; learning becomes a training for public office, not only for the god's service.

masked_spirit_drama.name: Masked Spirit Drama
masked_spirit_drama.observation: A masked actor moves slowly across a bare stage as a ghost returned to the place of his grief.

pilgrim_tale_cycle.name: Pilgrims' Tales
pilgrim_tale_cycle.observation: A company of pilgrims on the road tell tales in turn, and the knight, the miller and the widow each speak in their own voice.
pilgrim_tale_cycle.ability_reason: Tales in the everyday tongue give every rank a voice in one book; the common tongue becomes a language of literature.

courtesy_manners_books.name: Courtesy Books
courtesy_manners_books.observation: A little book tells boys not to spit across the table or wipe their fingers on their coats.

defence_of_women_book.name: Defence of Women
defence_of_women_book.observation: A widow who writes for her living builds in her book an allegorical city of worthy women, defending their worth by examples.

inward_devotion_movement.name: Inward Devotion
inward_devotion_movement.observation: Lay brethren living in common copy books, teach boys and practise a plain devotion without vows.

town_rhetoric_chambers.name: Rhetoric Chambers
town_rhetoric_chambers.observation: Each town's chamber of rhetoric enters a play in the contest, and the winning town carries home a silver prize.

single_point_perspective_painting.name: Perspective Painting
single_point_perspective_painting.observation: The painted chapel wall seems to open into a vaulted room, every line running to one point at the eye's height.
single_point_perspective_painting.ability_reason: Painters build pictures on a single vanishing point; images become measured windows, and patrons compete for them.

oil_glaze_painting.name: Oil Glaze Painting
oil_glaze_painting.observation: Thin glazes of pigment in linseed oil give velvet, brass and skin a glow no egg paint could reach.
oil_glaze_painting.ability_reason: Oil paint laid in glazes allows fine detail, depth and slow correction; painting becomes a trade of wealthy towns.

burgher_portraiture.name: Townsmen's Portraits
burgher_portraiture.observation: A merchant and his wife pose in their chamber, their mirror, fruit and little dog all painted to the life.

freestanding_bronze_statuary.name: Freestanding Bronzes
freestanding_bronze_statuary.observation: A bronze youth stands free in the courtyard, the first nude figure cast in the round since the old empire.

court_dance_manuals.name: Court Dance Manuals
court_dance_manuals.observation: A dancing master writes out the steps of each court dance with its music, so the same measures are danced in every palace.

revived_philosophy_academy.name: Revived Academy
revived_philosophy_academy.observation: In a villa outside the city, a banker's scholars translate the old philosopher and discuss the soul's ascent.

printed_vernacular_romances.name: Printed Romances
printed_vernacular_romances.observation: Printers sell romances of knights and fairies in the common tongue to every apprentice who can read.

tea_hut_ceremony.name: Tea Hut Rite
tea_hut_ceremony.observation: Guests stoop through a low door into a small hut, where the tea master whisks each bowl in silence.

dignity_of_person_oration.name: Dignity of the Person
dignity_of_person_oration.observation: A young count writes that the maker gave man no fixed place, so that he might shape himself.

soul_reckoning_morality_plays.name: Morality Plays
soul_reckoning_morality_plays.observation: Every soul is summoned by death, and one by one his friends, kin and goods abandon him on the cart stage.

dry_contemplation_gardens.name: Dry Rock Gardens
dry_contemplation_gardens.observation: Raked white gravel and a few stones are placed so that no viewer can see them all at once.

pedlar_chapbooks.name: Chapbooks
pedlar_chapbooks.observation: The pedlar's pack holds cheap chapbooks of giant-killers, prophecies and murders for the village fair.

printed_part_books.name: Printed Part-books
printed_part_books.observation: Many-voice songs are printed in separate part-books, one for each singer.

civic_marble_colossus.name: Marble Colossus
civic_marble_colossus.observation: A marble giant, a young slinger who felled a champion, stands before the town hall to warn tyrants.

painted_vault_cycle.name: Painted Vault
painted_vault_cycle.observation: For four years a painter works on scaffolding under the vault, painting the making of the world.
painted_vault_cycle.ability_reason: A great painted vault shows the god's story with the new skills; the god's house draws pilgrims and pride.
painted_vault_cycle.social_consequence: The fees paid for it are among the grievances the reformers print

trickster_jest_books.name: Jest Books
trickster_jest_books.observation: A wandering prankster tricks priests, innkeepers and burghers in every tale.

praise_of_folly_satire.name: Praise of Folly
praise_of_folly_satire.observation: Folly herself mounts the pulpit and praises the scholars, devotees and princes who serve her best.

ideal_commonwealth_fiction.name: Ideal Commonwealth
ideal_commonwealth_fiction.observation: A traveller describes an island where property is common and the magistrates are elected.

printed_reform_dispute.name: Printed Reform Dispute
printed_reform_dispute.observation: A preacher's theses against selling the god's pardons are printed in every town within weeks, and the god's house must answer in print.
printed_reform_dispute.ability_reason: Printed attacks on the god's house reach every town before it can answer; authority must now argue in print.
printed_reform_dispute.social_consequence: Towns and families split between the old rite and the reformed, and the dispute ends in wars

vernacular_scripture.name: Scripture in the Common Tongue
vernacular_scripture.observation: The god's books are translated into the common tongue and printed small enough for every household.
vernacular_scripture.ability_reason: Scripture in the everyday tongue makes reading a household duty and fixes a common written language.
vernacular_scripture.social_consequence: Lay readers interpret for themselves, and preachers can no longer control the text

everyday_tongue_hymns.name: Common-tongue Hymns
everyday_tongue_hymns.observation: The whole congregation sings plain hymns in the common tongue, to tunes the street already knows.

courtier_ideal_book.name: The Perfect Courtier
courtier_ideal_book.observation: A count describes the perfect courtier, graceful in arms, letters and speech, and doing it all with ease.

emblem_books.name: Emblem Books
emblem_books.observation: Each page pairs a woodcut, a motto and a verse; a tortoise under a sail means 'hasten slowly'.

masked_stock_comedy.name: Masked Stock Comedy
masked_stock_comedy.observation: Masked troupes improvise on the old miser, the braggart captain and the clever servant.

artists_lives_history.name: Lives of the Artists
artists_lives_history.observation: A painter writes the lives of the artists from the first masters to his own day.

sorcery_panics.name: Sorcery Panics
sorcery_panics.observation: After a hailstorm, a village accuses a widow of sorcery, and the magistrates' handbook teaches them how to try her.
sorcery_panics.social_consequence: Accusations spread from village to village, and hundreds die

drawing_academy.name: Academy of Drawing
drawing_academy.observation: Painters found an academy of drawing and free themselves from the guild's rules.

peasant_genre_painting.name: Peasant Genre Painting
peasant_genre_painting.observation: Peasants dance, eat and sleep under the painted trees of a harvest noon.

voyage_national_epic.name: Voyage Epic
voyage_national_epic.observation: An epic tells the realm's discovery of the sea road to the far east in the old heroic measure.

public_playhouses.name: Public Playhouses
public_playhouses.observation: A round wooden playhouse across the river holds three thousand, and a labourer pays one small coin to stand in the yard.
public_playhouses.ability_reason: Paying crowds of every rank see the same plays; the theatre becomes a common school of speech and history.
public_playhouses.social_consequence: Preachers denounce the playhouses as nests of plague and vice

personal_essays.name: Essays
personal_essays.observation: A retired magistrate writes about himself in a tower of books and doubts even his own judgment.

court_ballet_spectacle.name: Court Ballet
court_ballet_spectacle.observation: The ruler himself dances the sun in a spectacle of masks, machines and verse.

realm_history_plays.name: History Plays
realm_history_plays.observation: Plays of the realm's kings teach the groundlings their history and the price of civil war.

chiaroscuro_painting.name: Light and Shadow Painting
chiaroscuro_painting.observation: A single hard light falls on a tavern table where a tax collector is called from his counting.

sung_drama_opera.name: Opera
sung_drama_opera.observation: A court singer's story of the poet who went down to the dead is sung throughout, and the audience weeps.
sung_drama_opera.ability_reason: Drama sung throughout joins music, poetry and staging; courts and then towns build houses for it.

figured_bass_monody.name: Solo Song
figured_bass_monody.observation: A single voice sings over a lute and a bass line written with figures.

riverbank_dance_theatre.name: Riverbank Dance Theatre
riverbank_dance_theatre.observation: A shrine dancer performs on the dry riverbed, and the townspeople crowd to see her.

comic_knight_novel.name: Novel of a Deluded Knight
comic_knight_novel.observation: A poor gentleman who read too many romances rides out on his old horse to right wrongs that exist only in his books.
comic_knight_novel.ability_reason: A long prose fiction of ordinary life and delusion gives the novel its form, and readers learn to see through old ideals.

salon_conversation.name: Salons
salon_conversation.observation: A marquise receives poets, scholars and nobles in her blue chamber, and conversation becomes an art.

burgher_still_life.name: Still-life Painting
burgher_still_life.observation: A half-peeled lemon, an overturned cup and a lobster remind the burgher that all things pass.

tongue_purity_academy.name: Academy of the Tongue
tongue_purity_academy.observation: Forty academicians begin a dictionary of the tongue, deciding which words are fit for polite writing.

three_unities_tragedy.name: Tragedy of the Three Unities
three_unities_tragedy.observation: Tragedies keep to one action, one place and one day, and their heroes choose between love and duty.

public_opera_house.name: Public Opera House
public_opera_house.observation: The first public opera house opens for anyone who can pay, and the boxes are rented by the season.

civic_group_portraits.name: Group Portraits
civic_group_portraits.observation: The militia company pays to be painted marching out, each member paying for his place.

royal_art_academy.name: Royal Art Academy
royal_art_academy.observation: The royal academy teaches drawing from the model and judges each painting by its rank of subject.

coffeehouse_public_talk.name: Coffee-house Talk
coffeehouse_public_talk.observation: For a penny a man may sit, read the news sheets and argue politics with strangers over a dish of coffee.
coffeehouse_public_talk.ability_reason: Coffee-houses become a public forum: news, trade and politics are argued by strangers, and opinion becomes a power.
coffeehouse_public_talk.social_consequence: Rulers try to close them as seedbeds of sedition, and fail

perspective_scenery_stage.name: Perspective Scenery Stage
perspective_scenery_stage.observation: Painted wings recede to a vanishing point, and women take the women's parts.

royal_dance_academy.name: Royal Academy of Dance
royal_dance_academy.observation: The ruler founds an academy to fix the rules and positions of dance.

comedy_of_manners.name: Comedy of Manners
comedy_of_manners.observation: A comedy of a pious hypocrite is banned by the god's party and then allowed by the ruler.

first_fall_epic.name: Epic of the First Fall
first_fall_epic.observation: A blind poet dictates an epic of the first rebellion and the fall of the first man and woman.

verse_fables.name: Fables in Verse
verse_fables.observation: The fox, the crow and the ant speak in polished verse, and courtiers recognise themselves.

pilgrim_allegory_prose.name: Pilgrim's Allegory
pilgrim_allegory_prose.observation: A tinker in prison writes how a pilgrim leaves his doomed city and struggles through bogs, fairs and giants' castles to the gate of heaven.

public_collection_museum.name: Public Museum
public_collection_museum.observation: A founder's cabinets of coins, stones and stuffed animals open to the public in a university town.
public_collection_museum.ability_reason: Collections open to the public make objects evidence; students and visitors can compare specimens and relics for themselves.

floating_world_prints.name: Prints of the Floating World
floating_world_prints.observation: Cheap woodblock prints of actors and courtesans are sold in the pleasure quarter.

ancients_moderns_quarrel.name: Ancients and Moderns
ancients_moderns_quarrel.observation: The academy splits over whether modern authors can equal the ancients.

toleration_letter.name: Letter on Toleration
toleration_letter.observation: A physician-philosopher writes that no magistrate can force belief, and that rites should be tolerated.

puppet_duty_dramas.name: Chanted Puppet Dramas
puppet_duty_dramas.observation: Three puppeteers move each life-size doll while a chanter tells of lovers who choose death over dishonour.

fairy_tale_collections.name: Fairy Tale Collections
fairy_tale_collections.observation: A courtier writes down nurses' tales of wolves, ogres and clever cats, polished for the court.

hammer_keyboard.name: Hammer Keyboard
hammer_keyboard.observation: A keyboard maker's instrument strikes the strings with hammers and plays both soft and loud.

soloist_concertos.name: Concertos
soloist_concertos.observation: A priest-composer writes concertos for the orphan girls of his hospital, who play behind a grille.

periodical_essay_sheets.name: Essay Sheets
periodical_essay_sheets.observation: A daily sheet of essays on manners and taste is read over breakfast and discussed at the coffee-house.

bat_ball_wager_matches.name: Bat-and-ball Matches
bat_ball_wager_matches.observation: Village teams play bat-and-ball matches for a wager, and the gentry keep the score.

fraternal_lodges.name: Brotherhood Lodges
fraternal_lodges.observation: Gentlemen meet in lodges of a builders' brotherhood, swear secret oaths and toast each other as brothers.
fraternal_lodges.ability_reason: Secret lodges bring men of different ranks and rites together as equals, and spread ideas of reform through their correspondence.
fraternal_lodges.social_consequence: Priests and princes suspect the lodges of conspiracy

castaway_realist_novel.name: Castaway Novel
castaway_realist_novel.observation: A mariner tells how he lived alone for decades on an island, and many readers believe it true.

grand_tour_travel.name: Grand Tour
grand_tour_travel.observation: Young nobles tour the old cities of the south with a tutor, and return with statues, paintings and debts.

equal_temperament_tuning.name: Equal Temperament
equal_temperament_tuning.observation: A choirmaster writes preludes in every key to show a keyboard tuned in equal steps.

ballad_opera_satire.name: Ballad Opera
ballad_opera_satire.observation: A highwayman's opera sung to street tunes mocks the first minister, and the censors take note.

playful_shell_ornament.name: Shell-and-scroll Ornament
playful_shell_ornament.observation: Gilt shells, scrolls and flowers climb the salon walls and frame the mirrors.

satirical_print_series.name: Satirical Print Series
satirical_print_series.observation: An engraver's series follows a country girl from the coach to the brothel and a pauper's grave.

epistolary_novel.name: Novel in Letters
epistolary_novel.observation: A servant girl's letters to her parents tell how she resisted her master, and readers weep over her virtue.

public_oratorio.name: Public Oratorio
public_oratorio.observation: A sacred oratorio is sung in a concert hall to raise money for the foundling hospital.

landscape_park_gardens.name: Landscape Parks
landscape_park_gardens.observation: Walls are replaced by hidden ditches, and lakes, clumps of trees and temples are placed to look like wild nature.
landscape_park_gardens.social_consequence: Villages that spoil the view are moved out of the park

buried_town_excavation.name: Buried Towns Excavated
buried_town_excavation.observation: Diggers find a whole town buried under ash, with bread still in the ovens.

realm_public_museum.name: Realm Public Museum
realm_public_museum.observation: The realm opens its museum free to the public, with a library and collections of antiquities and natural history.
realm_public_museum.ability_reason: A national museum free to all makes heritage and learning a public possession rather than a princely one.

neoclassical_revival.name: Neoclassical Revival
neoclassical_revival.observation: Grave columns, plain pediments and white marble replace the playful shells of the last generation.

philosophical_satire_tale.name: Philosophical Satire
philosophical_satire_tale.observation: A naive young man travels a world of wars and earthquakes and learns that all is not for the best.

four_movement_symphony.name: Symphony
four_movement_symphony.observation: An orchestra of forty plays a symphony in four movements for a prince, and then for a paying public.
four_movement_symphony.ability_reason: The symphony becomes the grand public form of music; orchestras and concert halls anchor civic pride.

sentimental_novel.name: Novel of Feeling
sentimental_novel.observation: Readers weep over a novel of feeling and write to its author as if the heroine lived.

natural_education_treatise.name: Natural Education
natural_education_treatise.observation: A treatise tells parents to let a child learn from nature and experience rather than books and the rod.

ruined_castle_terror_tales.name: Tales of Terror
ruined_castle_terror_tales.observation: In a ruined castle, portraits walk, ghosts sigh in the vaults and a usurper's line is doomed.

subscription_concerts.name: Subscription Concerts
subscription_concerts.observation: Concerts are sold by subscription in a public hall, and a boy prodigy plays the keyboard blindfold.

annual_art_exhibition.name: Annual Exhibition
annual_art_exhibition.observation: The academy's annual exhibition is hung frame to frame, and critics review it in the newspapers.

string_quartet.name: String Quartet
string_quartet.observation: Two violins, a viola and a cello converse as equals in a nobleman's music room.

storm_passion_poetry.name: Storm and Passion
storm_passion_poetry.observation: Young poets write of storms, suicide and the rights of feeling against the rules of the academies.

folk_song_collections.name: Folk Song Collections
folk_song_collections.observation: A pastor collects the songs of the common people as the voice of each nation.

dare_to_know_essay.name: Dare to Know
dare_to_know_essay.observation: A philosopher tells readers to leave their self-imposed tutelage and dare to use their own reason.

servants_comic_opera.name: Servants' Comic Opera
servants_comic_opera.observation: A servant and his bride outwit their count on their wedding day, and the censor bans the play before it is sung.

national_civic_festivals.name: Festivals of the Nation
national_civic_festivals.observation: On a great parade ground, delegates of every department swear an oath to the nation before a vast crowd.

national_flag_anthem.name: Flag and Anthem
national_flag_anthem.observation: Soldiers march to a new song, and the new flag flies over every town hall.
national_flag_anthem.social_consequence: Old loyalties to lord and province give way to the nation, and to its wars

womens_rights_treatise.name: Rights of Women
womens_rights_treatise.observation: A woman writer argues that women need education and rights, not only manners.

plain_speech_nature_poetry.name: Plain-speech Poetry
plain_speech_nature_poetry.observation: Two poets publish ballads of shepherds and beggars in the plain speech of common men.
